phase: scenarios-frozen; current source receipt finalized separately before dispatch
sourceDataset: Independently authored after balanced-v5 fit was reported complete; evaluator files remain outside recommender inputs.
failurePolicy: Every assigned session stays in denominator; timeout/interruption/failure/abstention separated. No outcome-conditioned scenario replacement or rerun.
primary: Verified simulated checkout conversion and item revenue per assigned session, including all zero-purchase sessions.
secondary: Verified hard-constraint outcome including correct abstention
Private preference checks: met, known and total; conditional and assignment-wide denominators stated
Observed shopper steps and measured elapsed time; never treat partial observation span as full runtime
Browser-native rank/first-three/full readiness; scope and missing values retained
analysis: Raw paired counts; per-arm Wilson 95% binomial intervals for checkout; paired difference and paired bootstrap intervals for revenue/preference/effort with fixed seed recorded by analysis; no significance or human lift claim.
catalogAndPrices: Identical sixteen products/48 colors in both arms; displayed item price excludes delivery; quantity one.

priorSuite: Prior 20-attempt no-uplift results remain immutable; prior waterproof visibility failure motivates using only visible identity/price/color for positive cases, not changing outcomes.

combinedCohort.positiveCoverage: Each known product paired with each of its three private soft color preferences exactly once.

runtimePolicy.pilot: First five pairs from a separately frozen randomized full60 schedule are included in the main cohort and may not be retuned or replaced.
runtimePolicy.onDeadline: Stop new dispatch; preserve partial/in-progress outcomes and all unattempted assigned sessions with zero purchase in assignment-wide denominators. Never claim the remainder executed.

conversionInterpretation: Each block has eight purchase-feasible and two abstention pairs. Thus maximum correct-checkout conversion is48/60=80% per arm; correct abstention is a separate objective, never a purchase.
